tools.name: search_all_jobs
tools.description:
Search open jobs across ~24,000 companies at once - no company list needed.

Reads a daily index of every live public board on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby,
Workday, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Recruitee, Teamtailor, Breezy HR and Personio.
Jobs from the latest daily completed index (about 1.4 million re

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description:
Search live job postings for one company.

Provide either `company` (website, domain or careers URL - the ATS is detected
automatically) or `vendor` + `handle` (e.g. vendor="greenhouse", handle="stripe").
Workday companies must use a careers URL, e.g.
https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExter

tools.name: search_jobs_multi
tools.description:
Search several companies at once (up to 5), e.g. a target-account list.

Each company can be a website, domain or careers URL. Returns per-company
results plus a combined `jobs` list. `limit_per_company` is 1-20 (default 10).
Filters behave exactly like in search_jobs.

tools.name: detect_company_ats
tools.description:
Detect which ATS a company uses, without fetching its jobs.

Takes a website, domain or careers URL and returns the ATS vendor, handle
and how it was detected (URL pattern, careers page, or API probe). Useful to
confirm a company is supported before calling search_jobs.

tools.name: list_supported_ats
tools.description: List the 10 supported ATS vendors and what each needs as input.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "detect_company_ats" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
